newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: EASTERN GROUP BUYS STAKE IN CZECH HEAT FIRM.
newsitem.headline: EASTERN GROUP BUYS STAKE IN CZECH HEAT FIRM.

text.p: The Czech investment group PPF said on Friday it had agreed to seel a 28 percent stake in the Czech heating company Teplarny Brno a.s. to Britain's Eastern Group plc, a unit of Hanson plc .
In a statement PPF said that the deal was subject to approval by the Czech Economic Competition Office, but it should be concluded by the beginning of October.
It said that together with a roughly 25 percent stake in Teplarny Brno being sold by Europa Capital Management that Eastern Group would control a 52.8 percent interest.
Teplarny Brno is a regional heat provider based in the Czech Republic's second city.
PPF said that Eastern Group acquired the shares "for a premium price reflecting the value of a controlling stake."
Shares of Teplarny Brno, which posted a 1995 net profit of 179 million crowns on sales of 1.5 billion crowns, were up one crown on the Prague Stock Exchange's Friday session to 1,557.
